relations:
id(bytes=8)="CUSTOMER" ||--o{ id(bytes=5)="ORDER"   : places
id(bytes=8)="CUSTOMER" ||--o{ id(bytes=7)="INVOICE" : billed
id(bytes=5)="ORDER"    ||--|| id(bytes=7)="INVOICE" : invoices
